tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search verified incidents involving commercial robots and autonomous vehicles (robotaxis, delivery robots, humanoids, industrial arms, surgical and consumer robots). Every case has at least two independent sources and is followed from first report to investigation, recall, fine, lawsuit or settlemen

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Full record of one case by its reference (TMR-0123) or URL slug: summary, machine, dated timeline of what each source established, the sources with their tier and archive copy, and any linked NHTSA Standing General Order report.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Every company with at least one published case: number of cases, how many went beyond the first report, and the share. Not a safety ranking: the register counts reported incidents, not incidents per machine.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company's cases with harm and escalation counts, breakdown by incident type, and the category average for comparison.

tools.name: register_totals
tools.description: Headline numbers: cases, cases that reached a regulator, recall or court, archived sources, companies, earliest year, last update, cases by country, and totals of the NHTSA Standing General Order file.

tools.name: search_nhtsa_sgo
tools.description: Crash reports filed under NHTSA's Standing General Order 2021-01 by automated driving system (ADS) and Level 2 driver assistance operators, 2021 to today, one row per report at its latest version, or one row per incident when grain is 'incident' (filings by several entities about one crash collapsed

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cases, get_case · Private data: get_case, register_totals · Public sink: list_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cases, get_case · Private data: get_case, register_totals · Public sink: list_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
